steps.title: Deparaffinize slides with xylene and ethanol
steps.instruction: Incubate slides in xylene for 5 min, then transfer to a second jar of fresh xylene for another 5 min. Follow with 100 % ethanol for 5 min, then a second jar of fresh 100 % ethanol for 5 min. Continue with 90 % ethanol for 5 min and finish with 80 % ethanol for 5 min.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Prepare 3 % H₂O₂ in methanol immediately before use. Incubate slides in this solution for 10 min. Rinse slides in tap water for 5 min, then rinse in distilled water (DW) for 5 min.

steps.title: Apply primary antibody
steps.instruction: Wipe excess liquid around the tissue. Apply 40–50 µL of primary antibody solution (antibody should be diluted in Antibody diluent DAKO S8090; Ventana diluent is not suitable for Polink‑2 system). Incubate for 1.5 h at room temperature. Wash slides in TBST for 3 min, repeat three times.

steps.title: Polink‑2 Plus HRP detection
steps.instruction: Wipe excess liquid around the tissue. Apply 1 drop of Reagent 1 (enhancer) and incubate 15 min at room temperature. Wash slides in TBST for 2 min, repeat three times. Wipe excess liquid again, apply 1 drop of Reagent 2 (Polymer HRP) and incubate 25 min at room temperature. Wash slides in TBST for 2 min, repeat three times.

steps.title: Simple stain MAX PO detection
steps.instruction: Wipe excess liquid around the tissue. Apply 1 drop of the MAX PO reagent, incubate 45 min at room temperature. Wash slides in TBST for 2 min, repeat three times.

steps.title: ImmPRESS‑AP detection
steps.instruction: Wipe excess liquid around the tissue. Apply 1 drop of the ImmPRESS‑AP reagent, incubate 45 min at room temperature. Wash slides in TBST for 2 min, repeat three times.

steps.title: Peroxidase‑DAB chromogen development
steps.instruction: Wipe excess liquid around the tissue. Apply 60–100 µL of DAB reagent and incubate until a strong positive signal appears (typically 3–8 min, monitor under microscope). Rinse in tap water for 10 min, or alternatively rinse in DW for 3 min three times if another immunostaining step will follow.

steps.title: Alkaline phosphatase‑Vector Red development
steps.instruction: Wipe excess liquid around the tissue. Apply 60–100 µL of Vector Red reagent and incubate until a strong positive signal appears (typically 3–15 min, monitor under microscope). Rinse in tap water for 10 min, or alternatively rinse in DW for 3 min three times if another immunostaining step will follow.

steps.title: Counterstain with Hematoxylin
steps.instruction: Shake excess water off the slides. Incubate slides in Hematoxylin for 15 sec at room temperature. Wash slides in tap water for 10 min.

steps.title: Ethanol dehydration and mounting
steps.instruction: Shake excess water off the slides. Incubate slides in 100 % ethanol for 5 min, then transfer sequentially through three additional jars of fresh 100 % ethanol (each 5 min). Incubate slides in Hemo‑De (xylene alternative) for 5 min, then in two more jars of fresh Hemo‑De (each 5 min). Mount with a solvent‑based mounting medium.

steps.title: Heat dehydration for Vector Red (optional)
steps.instruction: Rinse slides in DW for 3 min and wipe excess water. Place slides on a hot plate set to 50 °C for 30–60 min. Incubate slides in Hemo‑De for 5 min, then in a second jar of fresh Hemo‑De for 5 min. Mount with a solvent‑based mounting medium.
